components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with spaces, dashes
            and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in
            E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no country code is
            given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city whose region is known, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it determines the
            owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

## What I implemented

The soft "possible duplicate" flag on owner creation, following the codebase's established pattern for creation-time observations (namesakeCount, bulkSignupWarning): compute against existing owners in a pipeline `Assign` step, persist on the entity, and expose via the MapStruct mapper.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added two readOnly fields to the `Owner` schema: `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32). These generate onto `OwnerDto`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added persisted field `Integer possibleDuplicateOf` (`@Column possible_duplicate_of`) with getter/setter. I persist only the id and derive the boolean, since `possibleDuplicate` is exactly "an id is present" — no redundant column.

3. **DB schema** — added `possible_duplicate_of INTEGER` to all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, postgres, mysql), needed because the test GETs the owner back by id.

4. **`AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java`** (new) — single-responsibility step mirroring `AssignOwnerNamesakeCount`: scans pre-existing owners for one sharing the built owner's last name (case-insensitive, per house style) and postcode but with a *different* telephone, and records the lowest matching id for determinism.
